note: Confirmation required before a class. Both an event and a thing to do — the split matters.
subject: Your Trial Class at ByteAcademy is tomorrow - Confirmation of attendance necessary!

messages.subject: Your Trial Class at ByteAcademy is tomorrow - Confirmation of attendance necessary!
messages.body: Hi Marcus, Please let us know if you will be attending the scheduled class tomorrow, at 16:00? Kindly note that we won't be able to conduct the class without the following: - A working computer or laptop (phones/tablets are not an option); - Camera and microphone enabled; - A parent present during the whole one hour long Trial Class. In case you do not have the necessary equipment, or you are not available to accompany your child, just let us know and we can easily reschedule the class. Final confirmation is required on the day of the class. You’ll receive a WhatsApp message 2 hours before it begins. If we don’t get a reply, we’ll reach out via phone. Confirmation is required at the latest 20 minutes before the class begins — otherwise, the booking will be cancelled. Lesson Link: Once you confirm your attendance, you will receive a platform access link with a code via email and WhatsApp 30 minutes before the session. If you don’t see it in your inbox, please check your spam/junk folder. Pemberton Setup: You will need to access the platform on a computer and meet the Pemberton requirements: a working microphone and a stable internet connection. You can test your connection here: https://www.speedtest.net/ If you have any questions, feel free to reply to this message! Thanks, ByteAcademy Coding Team
